arms.note: Variance check: the same arm three times, so run-to-run spread is measured instead of assumed.

arms.name: naive-flat
arms.note: The baseline is included because its spread is the denominator the treatment has to clear; a variance check on the treatment alone cannot say whether a gap is bigger than the noise.

queries.text: Across the retrieved papers, what methods do recursive language model systems use to aggregate information that exceeds a single context window, and how do they differ in where the aggregation happens?
queries.note: Pre-registered repeat cell: the most tool calls and the widest cost spread of the five pilot queries, so it brackets the high end of the variance.

queries.text: What ablations does the LENS harness itself report for its knowledge-graph verifier budget?
queries.note: Pre-registered repeat cell: the shortest run and the refusal path, so it brackets the low end. The two cells are chosen by rule before the runs; picking two of the twenty after seeing them would be selection.
